register_row.verdict: NOT flipped — mutes and watched words remain (slice 3)

prs.vidra-user: none — no frontend change was needed

lab.topology: one origin (a pipe-only node proxy on :3200 in front of `node .next/standalone/server.js` on :3100 and vidra-core on :8088), because vidra_refresh is SameSite=Lax and Path=/api/v1/auth
lab.postgres: native PostgreSQL 16 on a private port (55432), fresh cluster, migrated to schema 129
lab.redis: native redis on a private port (56379), flushed before seeding
lab.vidra_search: stood up natively on :8089 with its own database at search schema 16 — every index assertion is a readback of search.documents, not an inference
lab.media: TRANSCODING_ENABLED=true with ffmpeg 8.1; every upload is a real 36,859-byte mp4 through create -> upload-session -> PUT chunks -> complete
lab.frontend: production `next build` served from .next/standalone with .next/static and public copied in
lab.browser: real Chromium, hard reloads, one signed-in session at a time
lab.rate_limits: shipped defaults, never raised: general 120/min per IP (paced at ~109/min), auth 10/min per IP (one login per actor, 6.5 s apart)
lab.teardown: postgres and redis stopped and their data directories removed; both binaries, the search binary and the standalone build artefacts deleted; nothing left on 8088/8089/3100/3200
